sections.name: WeeklyBestCard
sections.title: Weekly average and personal best
sections.what: Shows a Weekly Benchmark card with this week's average score out of 100, the all-time best out of 100, a badge saying Personal Record or the percentage of best, and a progress bar. The average is the mean of the stored weekly history, or the current momentum score if there is none.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives a motivating comparison against the user's own best.
sections.watch_out: The card says 7 day average, but the code averages every entry in the stored history, so the label is only accurate if the history is trimmed to seven entries elsewhere.

summary: A card comparing this week's average momentum score with the user's best week, with a badge and a progress bar.
purpose: Motivates the user by showing how close their recent average is to their personal best.
why: Likely reason: a personal record comparison encourages steady progress.
how: The component reads the profile from the store. It averages the stored weekly history, or uses the current momentum score if there is no history. It takes the highest of the stored best, that average and the current score. It shows the two numbers, a Personal Record badge if the average equals the best, or the percentage of best, and fills a bar to that percentage.
inputs: The profile from the store: weekly history, best weekly score and momentum score. No props.
outputs: A display card. Nothing is saved, and the best score is read but never updated here.
risks: The label says 7 day average, but the code averages every entry in the weekly history. The best score can never be raised from this card.
debug: If the average looks wrong, check how many entries are in the weekly history and whether it is trimmed to seven. If the record badge shows when it should not, check the stored best score.
